title: Atomically record desired subscription candidate upon launch plan activation
business_goal: Record desired subscription candidate atomically under _OPTION_OWNERSHIP_LOCK when a valid sealed presession launch plan is activated, ensuring subscription state synchronization reaches complete=True and unblocking downstream candidate signal evaluation.
current_behavior: activate_market_event_graph_launch_plan stages option contracts but does not record the desired subscription candidate, leaving complete=False and tripping desired_subscription_candidate_invalid_or_stale -> SUBSCRIBE_FAILED -> ownership.state=UNKNOWN -> global_feed_unhealthy.
expected_behavior: activate_market_event_graph_launch_plan records the desired subscription candidate atomically upon validation, and invalidates fail-closed if the plan is unsealed, not OK, or option metadata resolution is blocked.
out_of_scope: live risk limits weakening or threshold bypassing
acceptance_criteria: Valid sealed launch plan records desired subscription candidate atomically
Unsealed or invalid launch plan invalidates candidate fail-closed
Blocked option metadata resolution invalidates candidate fail-closed
Candidate tokens reconcile against observation final_union_tokens
Safety non-negotiables are preserved (read_only=true, is_order_action=false, broker_api_called=false)
architecture_impact: Ensures deterministic atomic transition of WebSocket subscription candidate state from validated presession launch plans without race conditions or deadlocks.
qa_attack_plan: test valid sealed launch plan records candidate
test unsealed or not ok launch plan invalidates candidate
test metadata blocked plan invalidates candidate
test observation sync reconciles candidate tokens
uat_criteria: offline stability tests verify candidate registration and fail-closed invalidations
rollback_plan: Revert this scoped candidate registration change and its tests.

evidence_standard.applicability_reason: This work changes material feed subscription candidate tracking behavior and its focused regression coverage.

claims.statement: When activate_market_event_graph_launch_plan validates a sealed presession launch plan, it atomically records the desired subscription candidate under _OPTION_OWNERSHIP_LOCK, and invalidates fail-closed on unsealed or metadata-blocked plans.
claims.limitation: This claim covers candidate registration logic only; it does not authorize live orders or guarantee strategy profitability.
